One cached generic plan is always used
Planning is disabled

questions.text: Which practices make dynamic SQL in PL/pgSQL safer?

answers.text: Pass data values through USING
Build identifiers with format(%I) or quote_ident
Use quote_nullable/%L when inserting a possibly NULL value as text
Insert unknown text between $$...$$ in a dynamic string

questions.explanation: Data values should be passed through USING, identifiers formed with `%I`/quote_ident, and `%L`/quote_nullable used when text substitution is required. Simply dollar-quoting an unknown value does not provide safe escaping.

questions.text: Which statements about `$1`, `$2` parameters in EXECUTE ... USING are true?

answers.text: They substitute data values
They preserve native data types without converting values to text
They work only where the SQL command accepts query parameters
They can directly parameterize a table name

questions.explanation: Table and column names must be inserted into command text, while data values are preferably passed through USING.

questions.text: Which information can PL/pgSQL diagnostics provide?

PG_CONTEXT for the current call stack
Information about a handled exception through GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS
The raw contents of a WAL file

questions.explanation: PL/pgSQL provides both current diagnostics and stacked diagnostics for a handled error.
